# fakecloud_nameplate (Resource)

A plaque attached to a board, shown on the dashboard. Each board holds at most one; if it already exists, import it instead of creating another. text updates in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fakecloud_nameplate" "plaque" {
  board_id = fakecloud_tictactoe_board.lesson.id
  text     = "hello from terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `board_id` (Number) The board this plaque hangs on.
- `text` (String) What the plaque says. Changing it is an in-place update.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Server-assigned nameplate id.
